verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs describe a coherent single-flow payroll run: reviewing timesheets and hours inside the pay run (rippling-docs-25, rippling-docs-48), comparing current vs previous run totals (rippling-docs-1), adding bonuses and running on any schedule (rippling-docs-36, rippling-docs-38), and automatic tax calculation/filing on submission (rippling-docs-44). However, a documented real-world incident shows a single data formatting error (an extra CSV comma) caused a mass payroll run failure that delayed pay for ~20,000 employees, contradicting the implied reliability of this end-to-end flow (rippling-comm-1, rippling-comm-2). Missing for 10: independent hands-on walkthrough of the actual 'preview totals' screen and confirmation the flow has since been hardened against such failures.
